games.description: An unfinished solo home-invasion trial. Sark completes the initial house tasks, discovers the intruder’s movement and trap rules, dies repeatedly, searches for garage and attic tools, and stops after one last attic attempt.
games.title: An Uninvited Guest

games.description: A solo home-invasion horror story about actress Gin Harlow. Sark follows emails, deliveries, painkillers, and threatening encounters, then solves the movie-symbol code and reaches the abrupt ending.
games.title: Doxxed

games.description: Sark plays the seven horror shooters and investigates the abandoned arctic research base. The solo run begins with ghost photography, continues through diseased animals and bizarre worlds, and ends with a demon-hunting priest and the base’s finale.
games.title: Dread X Collection: The Hunt

games.description: Sark enters a haunted manor to steal a painting for his daughter’s medicine, solves its puzzles and survives the final maze and rat-filled chase.
